title: Daily Life in Finland
subtitle: 考点：不同地方的日常生活 / already / dark
passage: In Finland, winter days are short. At eight in the morning, it is still dark outside, and many students are already at school. After class, they often play ice hockey outside.
Home economics is an important part of school life. Students learn to cook and keep a home tidy. They finish their homework early and go to bed on time.
vocab: Finnish 芬兰语 · hockey 曲棍球 · ice hockey 冰球运动 · already 已经 · dark 昏暗的 · outside 在外面 · home economics 家政学 · part 部分
